title: Find the Maximum Number
description: Given a list of integers, find and return the maximum number in the list.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated integers.

title: Count Vowels
description: Given a string, count the number of vowels present in the string.
inputFormat: A single line containing a string.

title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target value, find two numbers whose sum equals the target.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and target. The second line contains N integers.
outputFormat: Print the indices of the two numbers.

title: Reverse a String
description: Given a string, return the string in reverse order.
inputFormat: A single line containing a string.

title: Sum of Array
description: Given an array of integers, calculate the sum of all elements.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The second line contains N integers.
